title: Nicaragua: from the Somoza dynasty to the Sandinista revolution
goal: I can say how the Somoza family ruled Nicaragua and how the Sandinistas took power, using the pluperfect.

items: I can say how long the Somoza family had ruled Nicaragua when the regime fell.
I can explain where the name of the FSLN comes from.
I can say when the Sandinistas took power and what they did in 1980.
I can use had + past participle for an event that came earlier.
I can use the new words for dynasty, ally and armed struggle.
